title: CENTCOM bottleneck on UAP information

tellings.quote: Central Command has a bottleneck to UAP information before it gets to the people

plain: A filmmaker and journalist, Jeremy Corbell, says that Central Command, the US military command that runs operations across the Middle East and Central Asia, acts as a bottleneck for information on UAP, the government's term for UFOs, before it ever reaches the public. If true, it would mean military reports of strange objects are held back at that level.
